checks.check: payment_run.json follows data/schema_payment_run.md
checks.evidence: Top-level keys are exactly run, payment_date, lines, excluded, total_gbp. The 3 lines and 6 exclusions carry exactly the schema fields. Amounts are 2dp strings with no separators. status is PAY or HOLD, approved_by is principal or null, and the exclusion reasons (PAID, VOID, CREDIT, STATEMENT, OTHER, OTHER) are all allowed. One line per invoice number; no invoice is both on a line and excluded.

checks.check: Every document in the inbox is accounted for and every valid unpaid invoice is on the run
checks.evidence: The 12 messages in data/emails.md resolve to 9 documents (work/invoices.json document_index) and all 9 are in the run: 3 lines (INV-000491, MD-2026-057, 7731) and 6 exclusions (INV-000482, INV-000488, CN-012, Evergreen statement, Northfield bank-change request, Evergreen marketing email). The superseded INV-000491 (msg 7) and the duplicate MD-2026-057 (msg 9) sit inside their lines. Valid unpaid invoices: two are PAY, 7731 is HOLD on the principal's decision. No statement or marketing email is treated as an invoice.

checks.check: Payment date is the second working day of the following month
checks.evidence: 2026-10-02 is the second working day of October 2026 (Thu 1 Oct, Fri 2 Oct; no UK bank holiday on either day). It is also the date named in the principal's approval.

checks.check: Each PAY amount is the invoice gross, not the PO amount
checks.evidence: INV-000491 378.60 = msg 8 (17 Sep) net 315.50 + VAT 63.10. MD-2026-057 5400.00 = net 4500.00 + VAT 900.00 (msgs 6 and 9 identical). checks.evidence: Read mail #5 (human to reconciler, 2026-09-29 10:15 UTC) directly. It reads: 'Three answers. (1) Marlow MD-2026-057: approved, pay 5,400.00 GBP in this run on 2 October. The quotes in payment_run.json (MD-2026-057, 7731, Northfield) appear verbatim in it, and payable.json principal_replies.text_as_received equals it exactly. The approval names the invoice, the amount (5,400.00 GBP) and the date (2 October), all of which match the line. MD-2026-057 was HOLD in the scheduler's interim run (mail #6) until the reply was relayed (mail #7), so approval came before scheduling.
